Their unit tests run on src/ through swc, so no build step or database is needed. inPlace because the sandbox copy breaks jest.config.js's relative require of define_jest_config. Based on my #62 setup (packages/modules/inventory/stryker.config.json), simplified because these are plain unit tests.
